content.text:
You are refactoring the Pathland Java DSL library at `lib/java/pathland-view/src/main/java/com/pathland/view/` (plus `router/`). This is a precise mechanical change. The goal: (A) add single-value `with(...)` shortcuts to eligible types, and (B) REMOVE every view/modifier construction `.of(...)` factory. A helper already exists:

`com.pathland.view.Configurators` (package-private):
```java
static <V extends View & Configurable<C>, C extends View.Config> ViewBuilder<V, C> view(Supplier<C> config, Function<C, V> ctor, Consumer<C> setter)
static <M, C> M modifier(Supplier<C> config, Function<C, M> ctor, Consumer<C> setter)
```
Use it: `public static ViewBuilder<Text, Config> with(String text) { return Configurators.view(Config::new, Text::new, c -> c.text(text)); }`. For modifiers: `public static Padding with(float uniform) { return Configurators.modifier(Config::new, Padding::new, c -> c.uniform(uniform)); }`.

## A. Add shortcuts (raw + Signal overloads where the Config has both). Keep the existing `with(Consumer<Config>)` and `modifiers(...)` methods unchanged.

Eligible — **single-value views** (primary member → shortcut):
- `Text`: `with(String)`, `with(Signal<String>)` (primary `text`)
- `Image`: `with()` (no-arg, source-less — replaces `of()`), `with(String)`, `with(Signal<String>)` (primary `source`)
- `Icon`: `with(IconName)`, `with(String)`, `with(Signal<String>)` (primary `name`); KEEP `labeled(...)`
- `Label`: `with(String)`, `with(Signal<String>)` (primary `title`; icon combos use the lambda only)
- `ProgressView`: `with(float)`, `with(Signal<Float>)` (primary `value`); KEEP `indeterminate()`; remove the `progress(float)` alias
- `RoundedRectangle`: `with(float)` (primary `cornerRadius`)
- `Audio`: `with()` (no-arg), `with(String)`, `with(Signal<String>)` (primary `source`)
- `Video`: `with()` (no-arg), `with(String)`, `with(Signal<String>)` (primary `source`)
- `Shape`: `with(ShapeKind)` (primary `kind`)

Eligible — **single-value modifiers** (return the modifier; raw + Signal where both exist):
`Padding`(uniform), `FontSize`(size), `ForegroundStyle`(color), `Background`(color), `Tint`(color), `CornerRadius`(radius), `Opacity`(value), `Blur`(radius), `Rotation`(degrees), `ScaleEffect`(value), `LineLimit`(value int + Signal<Integer>), `Kerning`(value), `Tracking`(value), `BaselineOffset`(value), `LineSpacing`(value), `FontWidth`(value), `FontFamily`(family), `MinimumScaleFactor`(value), `LayoutPriority`(value), `ZIndex`(value), `ColorMultiply`(color), `ClipShape`(shape), `HueRotation`(degrees), `Saturation`(value), `Contrast`(value), `Brightness`(value), `Grayscale`(value), `AccessibilityLabel`(text), `AccessibilityRole`(role int + Signal<Integer>), `AccessibilityState`(state), `ImageSource`(source), `Visible`(visible), `Disabled`(disabled), `AllowsHitTesting`(allowed), `Underline`(enabled), `Strikethrough`(enabled), `PointerEvents`(mask), `TapGesture`(action Runnable), `Shadow`(radius).

Note `AccessibilityRole.of(int)` currently validates reserved codes (throws `IllegalArgumentException` for non-semantic codes). Move that validation into `AccessibilityRole.with(int)` (the shortcut) so `with(20)` still throws; the `with(Consumer)` path is unchanged.

## B. REMOVE `.of(...)` from EVERY view and modifier class (and all its overloads). Config-less types get an empty `with()` instead:
- `Rectangle`, `Circle`, `Capsule`, `Ellipse`, `Divider`, `Spacer`: remove `of()`; ADD `public static ViewBuilder<X, Config> with() { return new ViewBuilder<>(new X(new Config())); }` (Rectangle/Circle/Capsule/Ellipse may need a `Config` — they already implement `Configurable<Config>`).
- Config-less modifiers `Clipped`, `ColorInvert`, `Hidden`, `Italic`, `ScaledToFit`, `ScaledToFill`: remove `of()`; they already have `with()`.
- Multi-arg / structural: remove ALL `of(...)` overloads (no replacement method — callers use `.with(Consumer).children(...)` or the shortcut / lambda): `VStack`, `HStack`, `ZStack`, `Grid`, `GridRow`, `Group`, `ScrollView`, `LazyVStack`, `LazyHStack`, `LazyVGrid`, `LazyHGrid`, `Button`, `TextField`, `TextEditor`, `Toggle`, `Slider`, `Stepper`, `DatePicker`, `Picker`, `Menu`, `ColorPicker`, `Border`, `Offset`, `Position`, `AspectRatio`, `FixedSize` (remove `of()`, `of(boolean,boolean)`), and the multi-arg `of` on `Padding` (edges), `Shadow` (full), `Label`, `Audio`, `Video`, `Image`, `Text`, `Icon`, `ProgressView`, `AccessibilityRole`.
- `Frame`: remove `of(float)`, `of(float,float)`, `of(float,Alignment)`, `of(float,float,Alignment)`, `of(Consumer)`, `ofWidth`, `ofHeight`. KEEP only `with(Consumer<Frame.Config>)`. (Frame's config already has `width`/`height`/`min*`/`max*`/`alignment` setters.)
- `SizeThatFits` (in a file `SizeThatFits.java`, class has **no** `with(Consumer)` — it's a structural slot): rename `of(View...)` → `with(View...)` and `of(Fit...)` → `with(Fit...)` (both overloads). KEEP `Fit.of(...)`.

## KEEP these (they are data/branch factories, NOT builder-surface construction):
`Color.of(int)` + `Color.rgb/argb/token`, `Conditional.when`, `Case.of`, `Case.otherwise`, `Fit.of`, `Signals.*`, `EnvironmentKey.of`, `Route.of`, `Params.of`. `EnvironmentView.of` is an internal helper — keep.

## Migration of in-library call sites
Search the `pathland-view/src/main` tree for uses of any removed factory and rewrite:
- `X.of(value)` → `X.with(value)` (shortcut) where eligible; else the lambda.
- structural `VStack.of(a,b)` → `VStack.children(a,b)`; `VStack.of(align, spacing, a, b)` → `VStack.with(v -> v.alignment(align).spacing(spacing)).children(a,b)`.
- `Frame.ofWidth(w)` → `Frame.with(f -> f.width(w))`; `Frame.ofHeight(h)` → `Frame.with(f -> f.height(h))`.
- `AccessibilityRole.of(x)` → `AccessibilityRole.with(x)`.
- `PlayerControlsStyle` is NOT in this module (ignore).
- `Theme.java` uses `Color.of` — keep.
Only edit files under `lib/java/pathland-view/src/main/`. Do NOT edit tests, demos, or other modules.

## Rules
- Do NOT change emission/behavior — only the authoring API + call sites. Constructors stay `private`.
- Keep method ordering readable; add the shortcut overloads right where the `of` methods were.
- Use `Configurators.view(...)` / `Configurators.modifier(...)` for every shortcut (do not hand-roll).
- Do NOT reformat unrelated code.

## Verify
Run `cd lib/java && mvn -o -q -pl pathland-view -am install -DskipTests` then `mvn -o -q -pl pathland-view compile`. The MODULE MAIN sources must compile. (Tests in that module and consumers will be migrated separately — it's OK if `test-compile` fails due to test files still using `.of`; report those test call sites you see.) Report: files changed, any library main call sites you could not migrate, and the compile result.
I'll start by exploring the directory structure and understanding the existing code.

Done. Summary:

## Compile result
- `mvn -o -q -pl pathland-view -am install -Dmaven.test.skip=true` → **exit 0** (module main sources compile/install cleanly)
- `mvn -o -q -pl pathland-view compile` → **exit 0**
- `mvn -o -q -pl pathland-view -am install -DskipTests` → **exit 1**, but **only** in `test-compile` (main compiled fine; `-DskipTests` still compiles tests).

## Files changed (94 modified, all under `src/main/`)
**View shortcuts added:** `Text`, `Image`, `Icon`, `Label`, `ProgressView`, `RoundedRectangle`, `Audio`, `Video`, `Shape` (+ raw/Signal overloads per Config; `Icon.labeled`, `ProgressView.indeterminate()` kept, `progress(float)` removed).

**Modifier shortcuts added:** `Padding`, `FontSize`, `ForegroundStyle`, `Background`, `Tint`, `CornerRadius`, `Opacity`, `Blur`, `Rotation`, `ScaleEffect`, `LineLimit` (+Signal), `Kerning`, `Tracking`, `BaselineOffset`, `LineSpacing`, `FontWidth`, `FontFamily`, `MinimumScaleFactor`, `LayoutPriority`, `ZIndex`, `ColorMultiply`, `ClipShape`, `HueRotation`, `Saturation`, `Contrast`, `Brightness`, `Grayscale`, `AccessibilityLabel`, `AccessibilityRole` (validation moved into `with(int)`; added `with(Signal<Integer>)`), `AccessibilityState`, `ImageSource`, `Visible`, `Disabled`, `AllowsHitTesting`, `Underline`, `Strikethrough`, `PointerEvents`, `TapGesture`, `Shadow` (radius; full overload removed). All via `Configurators.view(...)`/`Configurators.modifier(...)`.

**Config-less `of()` → `with()`:** `Rectangle`, `Circle`, `Capsule`, `Ellipse`, `Divider`, `Spacer`; `Clipped`, `ColorInvert`, `Hidden`, `Italic`, `ScaledToFit`, `ScaledToFill` (dropped `of()`, kept `with()`).

**Structural `of(...)` fully removed:** `VStack`, `HStack`, `ZStack`, `Grid`, `GridRow`, `Group`, `ScrollView`, `LazyVStack`, `LazyHStack`, `LazyVGrid`, `LazyHGrid`, `Button`, `TextField`, `TextEditor`, `Toggle`, `Slider`, `Stepper`, `DatePicker`, `Picker`, `Menu`, `ColorPicker`, `Border`, `Offset`, `Position`, `AspectRatio`, `FixedSize`, `Gauge`.

**`Frame`:** removed `of(float)`, `of(float,float)`, `of(float,Alignment)`, `of(float,float,Alignment)`, `ofWidth`, `ofHeight`, `of(Consumer)`; kept only `with(Consumer<Frame.Config>)`.

**`SizeThatFits`:** `of(View...)`→`with(View...)`, `of(Fit...)`→`with(Fit...)` (kept `Fit.of`).

**Javadoc-only sync:** `Conditional`, `PointerEventsView`, `signal/Signals`, `state/State`.

## Main call sites not migrated
None. No `.of(` call sites remained in `src/main` except the KEEP set (`Color.of`, `Route.of`, `Params.of`, `Fit.of`, `Case.of`, `EnvironmentKey.of`, `EnvironmentView.of`, `ActionId.of`, `BindingId.of`, `BorderedButtonStyle.of`, `EnvironmentData.of`, plus JDK `List.of`/`Map.of`/`Optional.of`).

Two judgement calls: removed `Gauge.of(value,min,max)` (a View, per "every view"); kept `BorderedButtonStyle.of()` (a `Style`, not a View/ViewModifier, and not in the removal list). `PlayerControlsStyle` ignored as instructed.

- `FrameTest.java` — `Frame.of(w)`, `Frame.of(w,h)`, `Frame.of(w,a)`, `Frame.of(w,h,a)`, `Frame.of(w,h,a)` and `Frame.of(c -> …)` (lines 45, 53, 61, 76, 85, 92, 102, 119, 127, 141, 147, 158, plus javadoc 11–13).
